MIYABISTS2-COMBAT_HARD_SELECTED.title: Challenge Difficulty
MIYABISTS2-COMBAT_HARD_SELECTED.hover.de:
Increasing difficulty also grants [gold]additional benefits[/gold]. This is ascetic training, and also cultivation.
[gold]1. Antimony Tier[/gold]: Enemies +10% HP
[gold]2. Zinc Tier[/gold]: At the start of each Act, randomly [red]downgrade[/red] one card
[gold]3. Tin Tier[/gold]: The first card played each combat [red]costs +1[/red]
[gold]4. Manganese Tier[/gold]: At combat start, enemies gain 1 Strength, you lose 1 Strength
[gold]5. Cadmium Tier[/gold]: Enemies HP buff increased to +20%
[gold]6. Nickel Tier[/gold]: [red]Draw 1 fewer card[/red] for the first 3 turns
[gold]7. Copper Tier[/gold]: Enemies deal 6 damage on death
[gold]8. Bismuth Tier[/gold]: Enemies HP +30%, additionally gain 1 Strength
[gold]9. Lead Tier[/gold]: Add a random [red]Curse[/red] to your deck upon entering a new Act
[gold]10. Mercury Tier[/gold]: The first time an enemy would take fatal damage, it gains 1 [gold]Buffer[/gold], 2 [gold]Strength[/gold], and recovers 30% HP
MIYABISTS2-MIYABI_FUN_PILE_SELECTED.hove:

[gold]Default[/gold]: No changes
[gold]Bangboo Household[/gold]: Starting deck becomes Bangboo-related cards
[gold]Bee Swarm[/gold]: Add 1 upgraded [gold]Bee Swarm[/gold] to the starting deck
